about: Outside tools agents can use. Nothing here is vendored: each plugin installs from its own project. Turn one on with `node harness/plugins.mjs enable <id>`; `node harness/plugins.mjs mcp` prints the MCP config for every enabled plugin. Pin versions; bump them on purpose.

plugins.name: rtk
plugins.what: Filters shell output before an agent reads it, and measures what it filtered (rtk gain).

plugins.name: qmd
plugins.what: Local search over the studio's markdown, so agents read the right paragraph instead of whole docs.

plugins.name: Serena
plugins.what: Symbol-level code lookup and edits over LSP for large codebases.

plugins.name: Playwright MCP
plugins.what: Browser control for agents: accessibility snapshots, screenshots, console.

plugins.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
plugins.what: Performance traces, network, console with source maps, Lighthouse audits for the web build.

plugins.name: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
plugins.what: Lets agents study how software is built: web bundles, Electron and Tauri apps, Godot PCK and Unity IL2CPP metadata, native binaries with Ghidra. Use it on other games for research and on our own build for bug hunting.
plugins.install: npx rea-agents@6.7.0 setup (asks before changing agent configs)

plugins.name: Watch Skill
plugins.what: Indexes screen recordings into timestamped frames, OCR text and transcripts that agents can search. Use your own recordings.

plugins.name: Blender MCP
plugins.what: Agents create and edit Blender scenes; complements the headless presets in tools/blender.

plugins.name: godot-ai
plugins.what: Agent control of the Godot editor for the Engine Transfer division.

plugins.name: Unity MCP
plugins.what: Agent control of the Unity editor for the Engine Transfer division.
